subject: floating observatory at sunset
art_direction: 圆顶小观测台立在漂浮岩台上，远处一只无标识小气球缓慢升起。
visible_description: 圆顶小观测台立在漂浮岩台上，远处一只无标识小气球缓慢升起。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint a compact domed observatory on a floating rock terrace at sunset. A curved stair follows the terrace edge and a few potted shrubs sit beside the closed door. Far away, one small unmarked balloon rises below the cloud line. Keep the observatory in the lower third, lit in muted peach and lavender. The upper sky should transition softly into quiet dusty pink with very little detail. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper. Keep the upper 20% naturally quiet for the clock, with no lettering, logos, or watermark.
